prompt: Style & Mood: High-end 3D CG cutscene render, Unreal Engine 5 quality. Deep black space with a radiant crystal at center, amethyst-and-gold inner light, concentric golden energy rings. Volumetric glow, ray-traced refraction through crystal facets, cinematic depth of field. Rendered CG, not a photograph, not a 2D painting. Narrative Summary: Within the Void hangs Astro — the rarest substance in the galaxy — a radiant crystal pulsing with power. Dynamic Description: A slow stabilized push-in approaches a single suspended crystal turning slowly in the dark, purple-and-gold light refracting through its facets, concentric rings of golden energy rotating around it. The crystal pulses, its inner light brightening with each beat. A macro insert punches to light refracting through a single sharp facet, then a slow orbit reveals the crystal in full as its glow surges, a burst of radiant gold blooming outward and filling the frame with warm light as the beat ends. Slow, reverent, weightless motion; wonder and power; the camera pushes in then orbits, never a flat zoom. Static Description: A single radiant Astro crystal suspended in black space, amethyst core with gold energy, concentric rotating rings, drifting light particles, distant faint stars.

风格与氛围：高端三维CG过场渲染，虚幻引擎5级别。深黑太空，中央一枚璀璨晶体，紫晶与金色内光，同心金色能量环。体积辉光，穿过晶体切面的光线追踪折射，电影级景深。CG渲染，非照片，非二维绘画。叙事概要：虚空之中悬浮着Astro——银河系最稀有的物质——一枚搏动着力量的璀璨晶体。动态描述：缓慢稳定的推镜靠近一枚在黑暗中缓缓旋转的悬浮晶体，紫金光芒穿过其切面折射，同心金色能量环环绕旋转。晶体搏动，内光随每次律动愈发明亮。微距插入切至光线穿过一道锋利切面的折射，随即缓慢环绕揭示晶体全貌，其辉光骤然涌动，璀璨金光向外迸发，以暖光充溢画面，段落收束。缓慢、虔敬、失重的运动；惊叹与力量；镜头先推进再环绕，绝非平直变焦。静态描述：黑色太空中悬浮的一枚璀璨Astro晶体，紫晶核心与金色能量，同心旋转光环，漂浮光粒，远方微弱群星。
